blocks.text: If your Order includes Hardware, the following terms apply. For product-specific requirements, refer to the applicable Product-Specific Hardware Terms below.
1.1. All Hardware is and shall remain the property of Zscaler during and after the Subscription Term. You acquire no ownership interest in the Hardware.
1.2. You shall not sell, lease, transfer, or repurpose the Hardware, or permit any third party to use the Hardware for any purpose.

1.3. You may install and use the Hardware solely at your premises, data center(s), or authorized partner locations for the purpose of enabling your authorized use of the applicable Zscaler service in accordance with the Documentation.
2.1. You shall not, and shall not permit any third party to:
a. Load, install, or run any software on the Hardware other than software provided or authorized by Zscaler;
b. Make any physical alterations or additions to the Hardware;
c. Attempt to repair, service, or maintain the Hardware except as expressly instructed by Zscaler;
d. Reverse engineer, disassemble, or decompile the Hardware or any software therein;
e. Without Zscaler's prior written consent, permit any person other than Zscaler or Zscaler-authorized agents to access, open, or service the Hardware; or
f. Relocate the Hardware from one physical location to another without prior written approval from Zscaler.
2.2. You shall handle all Hardware with reasonable care and shall not subject the Hardware to misuse, abuse, neglect, or mishandling.
3.1. Zscaler shall suitably pack and ship Hardware to the address specified by you in the applicable Order.
3.2. You shall provide a local point of contact for delivery, accurate shipping information, and any assistance or cooperation required for customs clearance.
3.3. Zscaler shall not be liable for shipping delays caused by customs processing, regulatory compliance, carrier delays, or other factors beyond Zscaler's reasonable control.

3.4. If delivery fails due to incorrect shipping information provided by you, your refusal of delivery, or your failure to provide a local contact, all costs incurred by Zscaler (including storage, return shipment, and re-delivery) shall be reimbursed by you.
3.5. You shall perform physical installation of Hardware in accordance with Zscaler's specifications and Documentation, unless otherwise specified in the applicable Product-Specific Hardware Terms.

4.1. Technical Representative. You shall appoint at least one technical representative with physical access to the Hardware and authority to grant Zscaler or its authorized agents physical access to the Hardware location. Your technical representative shall respond to Zscaler requests within a commercially reasonable timeframe.
4.2. Environment. You shall, at your expense:

a. Maintain the Hardware in an environment that meets Zscaler's operating conditions for the applicable Hardware, including temperature, humidity, and other environmental conditions as specified in the Documentation; and
b. Provide continuous, uninterrupted power supply to the Hardware with suitable surge protection.

4.3. Device Count and Capacity. You shall maintain a sufficient number of Hardware units as recommended by Zscaler. If Zscaler determines that your traffic or usage exceeds Hardware capacity, you shall, within thirty (30) days of notification, accommodate additional or upgraded Hardware or take action to reduce utilization in accordance with Zscaler's guidance.
4.4. If you relocate Hardware with Zscaler's prior written authorization, you shall be responsible for all associated costs, including licenses, permits, shipping, VAT, taxes, and applicable duties.
5.1. During the Subscription Term, Zscaler shall provide remote management, monitoring, and maintenance for all Hardware. Zscaler may update, upgrade, or replace Hardware at its sole discretion.
6.1. If Hardware fails or becomes defective during the Subscription Term, Zscaler shall provide advance replacement Hardware, subject to availability.
6.2. Zscaler will ship replacement Hardware within one (1) to three (3) business days of confirming the failure.
6.3. All Hardware repairs and replacements are subject to Zscaler's Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) process. You shall not return Hardware without first obtaining an RMA number from Zscaler.
6.4. Upon receipt of replacement Hardware, you shall return defective Hardware to Zscaler within thirty (30) calendar days using the return instructions provided by Zscaler.
6.5. You shall perform physical setup of replacement Hardware in accordance with Zscaler's instructions, unless otherwise specified in the applicable Product-Specific Hardware Terms.

6.6. You are responsible for removing all data from Hardware prior to returning or disposing of the Hardware. Zscaler is not responsible for the security or return of any data remaining on Hardware returned to or disposed of by you.

blocks.heading: 7. Return Upon Termination or Expiration of Subscription Term

blocks.text: 7.1. Upon termination or expiration of the Subscription Term, you shall return all Hardware to Zscaler within twenty-one (21) calendar days.

7.2. Zscaler shall provide an RMA number, return packaging and shipping instructions. Zscaler shall bear the cost of return shipping. In cases where return is not cost-effective due to the age of the Hardware or shipping costs, Zscaler may instruct you to dispose of the Hardware in accordance with your internal disposal policies. You shall provide Zscaler with a Certificate of Destruction and shall bear any costs associated with such disposal.

7.3. If you fail to return Hardware within twenty-one (21) calendar days of termination or expiration, Zscaler may invoice you for the replacement value of such Hardware and may engage authorized contractors to retrieve the Hardware at your expense.

7.4. Evaluation Hardware. If Hardware was provided for evaluation, proof of concept, or trial purposes, you shall either (a) return the Hardware to Zscaler within twenty-one (21) calendar days following the end of the evaluation period, or (b) convert to a paid production subscription for the applicable Zscaler service before the end of the evaluation period. If you do not return the Hardware or convert to a paid subscription, Sections 7.3 and 9.1 apply.
8.1. Zscaler's obligations under these Hardware Usage Terms do not apply to:
a. Hardware, software, or components not provided by Zscaler;
b. Hardware that has been modified, altered, or serviced by anyone other than Zscaler or Zscaler-authorized agents;
c. Hardware used beyond the useful life advised by Zscaler;
d. Damage caused by events or conditions beyond Zscaler's reasonable control, including fire, flood, earthquake, power surge, or other force majeure events;
e. Hardware used or stored in an environment that does not meet Zscaler's published specifications;
f. Hardware obtained from any source other than directly from Zscaler or an authorized Zscaler Partner; or
g. Situations in which you are unresponsive or unwilling to cooperate with Zscaler's reasonable requests for access, information, or assistance.

9.1. Contractor Engagement. If you are unresponsive or unwilling to assist with installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, or return of Hardware, Zscaler may engage authorized contractors to perform such tasks. You shall reimburse Zscaler for all reasonable costs incurred.

9.2. Service Level Agreements. Your failure to comply with any obligation under these Hardware Usage Terms, including the applicable Product-Specific Hardware Terms, shall result in the invalidation of any and all related Service Level Agreements for the affected Zscaler service.

The following Product-Specific Hardware Terms supplement the Hardware Usage Terms and apply to the specific Hardware identified in your Order. In the event of a conflict, the Product-Specific Hardware Terms control for the applicable Hardware.

For the purpose of Section A, the term "Hardware" should mean the hardware provided by Zscaler to you as Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) appliances. The following additional terms apply if your Order includes Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) appliances:
A.1. Minimum Device Count. You shall maintain no fewer than two (2) Hardware units per installation location.
A.2. Internet Redundancy. You shall provide internet connectivity through no fewer than two (2) discrete internet service providers with redundant capabilities at each installation location.
A.3. 24/7 Technical Staff. You shall ensure that personnel capable of responding to Zscaler requests and providing physical access to the Hardware are available 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

A.4. Installation and Setup. You are responsible for the physical installation of Hardware in accordance with Zscaler's published instructions. Zscaler Cloud Operations will manage the configuration and ongoing operation of the Hardware.
A.5. Maintenance Windows. You shall notify Zscaler of any scheduled maintenance windows that may affect the operation or connectivity of the Hardware.

A.6. Connectivity and Network Configuration. You shall: (a) Provide and maintain dedicated internet connectivity sufficient for the Hardware to communicate with the Zscaler cloud; (b) Configure firewall and network settings in compliance with Zscaler's published requirements; and (c) Provide and maintain all required IP addresses, DNS settings, and network resources as specified by Zscaler.

A.7. Repair and Replacement. The repair and replacement process for the Hardware is managed by Zscaler Cloud Operations. Zscaler will coordinate replacement directly with you in accordance with the procedures described in the applicable support documentation.

For the purpose of Section B, the term "Hardware" should mean the hardware provided by Zscaler to you as Zero Trust Branch appliances. The following additional terms apply if your Order includes Zero Trust Branch appliances:
B.1. 24/7 Availability. You shall ensure personnel with physical access to the Hardware are available to respond to Zscaler requests 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

B.2. Technical Representative Training. Your technical representative shall be fully trained, at your expense, on the Hardware's basic specifications and operational requirements through Zscaler-provided or Zscaler-approved documentation.
B.3. Remote Connectivity. You shall provide Zscaler with remote connectivity access to the Hardware for management and troubleshooting purposes.
B.4. Customer Setup. You are responsible for the physical setup and rack-mounting (if applicable) of the Hardware in accordance with Zscaler's published instructions.

B.5. Connectivity and Network Configuration. You shall: (a) Provide and maintain dedicated internet connectivity sufficient for the Hardware to communicate with the Zscaler cloud; (b) Configure firewall and network settings in compliance with Zscaler's published requirements; and (c) Provide and maintain all required IP addresses, DNS settings, and network resources as specified by Zscaler.

For the purpose of Section C, the term "Hardware" should mean the hardware provided by Zscaler to you as Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) appliances. The following additional terms apply if your Order includes Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) appliances:
C.1. 24/7 Availability. You shall ensure personnel with physical access to the Hardware are available to respond to Zscaler requests 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

C.2. Technical Representative Training. Your technical representative shall be fully trained, at your expense, on the Hardware's basic specifications and operational requirements through Zscaler-provided or Zscaler-approved documentation.
C.3. Remote Connectivity. You shall provide Zscaler with remote connectivity access to the Hardware for management and troubleshooting purposes.
C.4. Customer Setup. You are responsible for the physical setup and rack-mounting (if applicable) of the Hardware in accordance with Zscaler's published instructions.
